document.abstract: Amendment 1 to SMPTE RP 2057:2011 changes the Set Key and Scheme Label UL values for the Text-based Descriptive Metadata Scheme. The purpose of this change is to fix the conflict of Set Key and Scheme Label UL values between SMPTE RP 2057 Text-based Metadata and AMWA AS-03. This amendment also provides changes to the descriptions and the meanings of byte values in the Set Key and Label UL.
